slide.heading: Dire l’âge — say the age
slide.lead:
Il a douze ans. — He is twelve.
Elle a quinze ans. — She is fifteen.

points.label: Age
points.text: Use a… ans, not est… ans.

points.label: Correction
points.text: Il est douze ans. ✗ → Il a douze ans. ✓

figure.alt: French spellings for the numbers one to twenty.
